name: Crocolisk Hunting
summary: At Farstrider Lodge, Marek Ironheart seeks hardy trackers to hunt Loch Modan's crocolisks. Their skins and meat bring steady trade, though the hunt along the lake's shores and islands is dangerous.

sections.title: A Lucrative Quarry
sections.body: Loch Modan's mountain waters look calm, but fierce predators lurk beneath the surface. Crocolisks gather in the shallows and along muddy banks, making crossings and fishing dangerous for the unwary. At Farstrider Lodge, these reptiles are valuable game. Craftsmen and tailors across Khaz Modan seek their durable hides for rugged armor and leather goods. Rustic taverns pay well for fresh cuts of their lean, flavorful tail meat.

sections.title: Jaws in the Shallows
sections.body: Crocolisk hunting in Loch Modan calls for more than novice trapping. The beasts gather mainly around the lake's rocky islets, where bone-crushing jaws and razor-sharp teeth make them dangerous opponents. Dwarven veterans such as Marek Ironheart bear scars from wrestling them into submission. He warns newcomers that one misstep in the water can cost a limb. Skinning and butchering a crocolisk takes patience, sturdy steel, and a willingness to enter its hunting ground.

faq.q: Why are crocolisks hunted in Loch Modan?
faq.answer: Merchants and craftsmen value crocolisk hides for rugged clothing and leather armor, while local cooks prize the meat. Farstrider Lodge trades in these goods to supply traders passing through Khaz Modan.

faq.q: Where are the crocolisks usually found?
aliases: where to find crocs loch modan
faq.answer: Crocolisks live in Loch Modan's muddy shallows and along its banks, especially around the rocky islands in the center of the lake.

Marek Ironheart is a veteran dwarven mountaineer and hunter stationed at Farstrider Lodge in southeastern Loch Modan. He trades in local wildlife materials and recounts close calls with the Loch's fiercest beasts.

faq.q: What makes hunting them so hazardous?
aliases: why are crocs hard to hunt
faq.answer: Loch Modan's crocolisks are aggressive, territorial predators with powerful jaws and dagger-sharp teeth. Hunters face them in deep water or on isolated islets, where the terrain favors sudden attacks by the reptiles.

faq.q: Is crocolisk meat actually safe and edible?
faq.answer: Yes. Once properly dressed and roasted, crocolisk meat is prized by frontier cooks and tavern patrons across the dwarven lands for its firm texture and rich flavor.
Farstrider Lodge is an outpost in southeastern Loch Modan. It gives Alliance hunters, trackers, and mountaineers a haven and a place to prepare for watching the valley's wild reaches.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can test your nerve at Farstrider Lodge against Loch Modan's aquatic dangers.
As a cook, you can make hearty stews and roasts with tough, lean crocolisk meat.
As a dwarf, you can take pride in taming Loch Modan's wilderness and make an honest living through crocolisk hunting.
